# Files that neither CI nor the shipped binaries use: a pull request that
# only touches these skips CI (its jobs report as skipped, and the "CI"
# check passes), and a push to main that only touches these and the files
# of ci-only.txt is tested but not released.
# One bash `case` glob per line, matched against the path from the repo
# root (`*` also matches `/`). Lines starting with # and blank lines are
# ignored.
#
# The VS Code extension's files (editors/vscode/**, its README included)
# ship in its package, so they are not listed here.

readme.md
todo.md
CLAUDE.md
LICENSE
.vscode/*
*.code-workspace
.cspell.jsonc
.editorconfig
.envrc
.gitignore
.markdownlint-cli2.jsonc
.markdownlint.jsonc
